purpose: Append-only pre-freeze record of ledger wording displaced by a normative change, for entries in the IMMUTABLE initial claim ledger. The initial ledger (P0-G1a) exists so that claim drift during the analyses is detectable rather than reconciled after the fact; rewriting it to look as though the current estimand had always been the pre-analysis state would destroy exactly the evidence it was created to preserve. Displacement is therefore recorded here and the ledger is left byte-identical.

entries.field: assurance basis of PR-03a, and eventual_upper_precondition_status
entries.recorded_wording: PR-03a assured on numerical convergence: 27/27 operator-distinct cells converge, worst attained error 1.04e-11, endpoint agrees with the independent high-kappa limit to ~1e-12
entries.why_displaced: The disposition was already 'assured', but the basis was a finite high-kappa sequence. That is a diagnostic and cannot distinguish a genuine limit from a well-behaved integrator, so it could not license the eventual-upper reading. The basis is now a proved fixed-positive-time singular limit whose assumptions are verified at every declared cell, with the sequence demoted to a diagnostic that proves nothing. The NAME of the disposition is unchanged; the basis is not, which is exactly the kind of silent strengthening this ledger exists to make visible.
entries.replacement_wording: PR-03a assured on a proof: for each fixed T > 0, exp((A0 + kappa A1)T) -> N exp((L^T A0 N)T) L^T under a semisimple zero of A1 and a strictly stable nonzero spectrum, with M, gamma and kappa_0 derived from the operator; assumptions verified at all 27 operator-distinct cells covering all 54 declared cells

precondition_status_change.what_it_does_NOT_change: no endpoint classification, no H1 group or programme rule, no threshold family, no WIDE reference formula, no tolerance, no grid size, and no error-budget allocation. The mapping from endpoint_classification to eventual_upper_status is unchanged; what changes is whether the enumerated value may become scoped reader-facing prose.
precondition_status_change.scope_of_what_is_now_permitted: the declared model, the declared cells, and a FIXED POSITIVE time. Convergence is NOT uniform at t = 0 for off-manifold initial data and no such claim is licensed. Nothing here speaks to real espresso: PR-12 remains OPEN-AND-SCOPED.

entries.superseded_by: D-03 corrects two defects in the artefact this entry bound

entries.field: the PR-03a proof artefact and the semisimplicity verifier
entries.recorded_wording: (A) ||r_kappa(T)|| <= C_T/kappa + M_T exp(-gamma kappa T)||Q z0|| with C_T claimed to be derived from operator, basis and T alone; (B) semisimplicity decided by the rank at the globally largest singular-value gap, with the claim that a defective zero produces no such gap
entries.why_displaced: (A) The displayed bound was NOT homogeneous in z0. The proof defined K and sup u through u(0) = ||L^T z0|| and v(0) = ||M^T z0||, both linear in z0, so the claimed operator-only C_T was not operator-only. Scaling exposes it: replacing z0 by alpha z0 multiplies the residual by |alpha| while a bare C_T/kappa does not move. (B) The largest-gap rule is unsound. For block_diag(Jordan2(0), [-1e9]) the singular values are [1e9, 1, 0] and [1e18, 0, 0], so the largest gap falls between the fast block and the Jordan singular value rather than at the nonzero/zero cut; the rule returned rank 1 for both and called a DEFECTIVE zero semisimple. The crossover is set by the gap floor itself, so the justification given for that floor was self-refuting. The earlier Jordan-2 and Jordan-3 fixtures used comparable block scales and could not expose it.
entries.replacement_wording: (A) ||r_kappa(T)|| <= (C_T/kappa)||z0|| + M_T exp(-gamma kappa T)||Q z0||, with K_T = (2M/gamma)[||M^T|| + c T exp(aT)||L^T||], U_T = (||L^T|| + b K_T/kappa_1) exp(aT), C_T = ||N|| b K_T exp(aT) + ||W|| M c U_T/gamma and M_T = ||W|| M / sigma_min(W), all independent of z0. (B) The structural rank is DECLARED from the model (expected_fast_rank = 2*nz = 400, expected_slow_nullity = nz+1 = 201) and VERIFIED at that cut, with agreement required across the structural rank, the SVD null-basis rank and the ordered-Schur fast-mode count, plus a nonsingular conditioned slow pairing. Any disagreement is not_assured.
entries.also_corrected: Terminology: the output is a linear functional, hence a COVECTOR. It lies in ker(A1^T), equivalently e_out Q = 0; it cannot 'lie in ker(A1)'. Wording only - the construction and the numerical check were already correct.
entries.new_failure_modes_distinguished: A defective kernel (a retained slot is exactly zero) and a numerically undecidable rank (a retained value below eps*max(s), which occurs when the internal scale ratio exceeds what double precision resolves after squaring) are now reported separately. Both fail closed.

precondition_status_change.why_unchanged: the corrected theorem and repaired verifier pass at all 27 cells with the 54-cell mapping complete, so the closure condition that permitted 'assured' in D-02 still holds after correction
